content: The water in the pot reflects the sun; when the pot breaks, the light returns to its universal source.
author: Kabir
explanation: Live lightly and gracefully without demanding monuments to your name. Do good deeds quietly and let them dissolve into the universal stream.
practicalInsight: Perform a kind deed today and tell absolutely no one about it.
reflectionPrompt: Am I doing good to feed my legacy, or for the pure joy of service?
